## Before you ask for review

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), as CONTRIBUTING.md explains.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated with the change.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run drift` pass; no generated file was edited by hand.
- [ ] A change to what `@ox1audio/sdk` exports or does has a line in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Nothing a page or script written today relies on was renamed or removed. If it was: why, and what its author does instead.
- [ ] No secrets, and no audio you don't have the right to share.
